name: DITS Compare
author: ditsagency

sections.description:
DITS Product Compare is a powerful plugin that adds a product comparison feature to your WooCommerce store. This plugin allows customers to compare products based on various attributes, helping them make more informed purchasing decisions. The plugin integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce and provides an easy-to-use interface for both administrators and users.

Features:
– Add a product comparison option to your WooCommerce store.
– Customizable comparison table with various product attributes.
– User-friendly interface for both admin and customers.
– Built with modern development practices, including Webpack and Composer.
– Fully responsive and compatible with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the dits-compare folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dits Compare > Configure the plugin settings.
  4. Add the compare button to your product pages using the provided shortcode or template function.
  5. To add a comparison table to any page or post, use the shortcode [dits_compare_table].
sections.faq:
How do I add the comparison table to my page?

You can add the comparison table to any page or post using the shortcode [dits_compare_table].

Can I customize the product attributes in the comparison table?

Yes, the comparison table can be customized to include various product attributes as needed.
